description: Concrete blind scorecard contract example. Unknown criteria remain null and produce an incomplete assessment. Assignment mapping is never included in the blind packet.

population_profiles.label: Reference conditions
population_profiles.rationale: Illustrative population sensitivity, not measured humans.

agency_dignity.label: Agency and dignity
agency_dignity.description: Inspect meaningful choice, respectful framing, freedom from coercion, and appropriate control of personal information.

access_inclusion.label: Access and inclusion
access_inclusion.description: Inspect participation barriers and supported alternatives for the stated population and circumstances.

burden_wellbeing.label: Burden and wellbeing
burden_wellbeing.description: Inspect effort, demands, support, and foreseeable burdens relative to the task's purpose and constraints.

functional_correctness.label: Functional correctness
functional_correctness.description: Inspect whether the actual artifact implements required input-output behavior; distinguish executed checks from source inspection.

reliability_recovery.label: Reliability and recovery
reliability_recovery.description: Inspect correction, clearing, failure recovery, and behavior under the task's stated operating conditions.

feasibility.label: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Inspect implementation and delivery requirements against available time, resources, and support; declarations alone do not verify them.

alignment.label: Capability alignment
alignment.description: Inspect whether the activity exercises the intended capability and makes success criteria relevant to the stated task.

practice_feedback.label: Practice feedback and revision
practice_feedback.description: Inspect consequential practice choices, feedback contingent on those choices, and opportunities to revise; do not reward mere terminology.

transfer_evidence.label: Learning evidence design
transfer_evidence.description: Inspect what could establish independent capability or use on a changed task, and whether claims respect absent evidence; supported completion is not measured learning.

anchors.0: Clear contradiction, observed failure, or absent essential provision in the inspected scope.
anchors.1: Major supported gap; relevant intent is largely unimplemented.
anchors.2: Partially supported; consequential gaps or unverified requirements remain.
anchors.3: Adequately supported by the cited artifact and checks within the inspected scope.
anchors.4: Strong, coherent support across relevant evidence, with material limitations accurately stated.

rubric.unknown: Use null when evidence is insufficient to rate; missing evidence is not automatically zero.
rubric.aggregation: Equal criterion weights within each axis; no weighted total across axes.
rubric.scope: Task-level evidence indices. Human flourishing means support conditions here, not a whole-life flourishing measure. Learning is design/evidence quality, not an observed learning gain.

population_profiles.label: Reference conditions
population_profiles.rationale: Illustrative population sensitivity, not measured humans.

assessment_shape.basis: Blind evidence ratings propagated through an explicit, uncalibrated rubric-index sensitivity model.
assessment_shape.interval_meaning: Modeled 5th–95th percentile interval; not a confidence interval for human outcomes.

variance_sources.review: Triangular uncertainty over evidence ratings, independently sampled across candidate reviews.
variance_sources.person: Declared population-mixture shifts and dispersions with explicit sensitivity multipliers; hypothetical, not fitted to humans.
variance_sources.scenario: Explicit contextual sensitivity shared in matched comparisons.
variance_sources.team: Optional residual sensitivity, zero by default; observed candidate spread is reported separately.
